note: Burke County campground on the Short Creek Dam reservoir north of Columbus, with campsites spread under scattered trees inside a shelterbelt; shelter and fishing docks. Game and Fish lists a Short Creek Wildlife Management Area at the same spot. --Claude
summary: Only official page: Burke County visitors page (40 RV sites with electricity, shelter, 6 fishing docks, call 701-939-5681); no fee, season or booking stated. Game and Fish lists Short Creek WMA '5.5 miles north of Columbus' with 'Overnight camping prohibited Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except holidays' - whether that binds the county campground is unconfirmed. Lakeview stands at most (sites 50-60 m from the water behind a shelterbelt and loop road). Pin ok. Website -> county page.
flags: WILDLIFE AGENCY (WMA): gf.nd.gov/wma-listing: 'Burke Short Creek 5.5 miles north of Columbus. Overnight camping prohibited Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except holidays.' That is this reservoir (the campground is 5.5 mi north of Columbus; dam registers list ND Game & Fish as the dam's owner). The county's page describes 40 electric RV sites and says nothing about closed nights. Unresolved: whether the county campground sits on the WMA and is bound by the Tue/Wed prohibition, or is a separate developed area. If it binds, it is a recurring closed-nights rule worth a booking note; it does not make the camping a parking-lot allowance (40 designated electric sites, county run). AWH to decide; a phone answer from 701-939-5681 would settle it.
FEES: none on any official page. Aggregators disagree (Wilderspot 'no fee', Campendium '$10'); nothing written.

BOOKING: stored reservable true (derived from the old note's 'Contact Burke County JDA to camp') is not confirmed: the county page says only 'Call for more information'; an aggregator says first-come, first-served. Left alone, unconfirmed; AWH may want it cleared.
HOOKUPS: 'RV hookups with electricity' (county) - electric present, amperage unstated (an aggregator says 30 A); no hookups group written.

WATERFRONT: stored lakeview stands, as a ceiling. The camping area is a tree-dotted oval (~48.9908,-102.7826) whose north edge is a dense shelterbelt, then the loop road, then 20-30 m of grass to the reservoir; nearest camping ~50-60 m from the water over the tree row and road (north row ~48.9913,-102.7830). Behind a tree band and the loop road: no on-water value; the shelterbelt may block the view, so not waterfront is the alternative if AWH reads it that way. Sites are undesignated spots under scattered trees, not numbered pads, on imagery.

WEBSITE: old https://www.ndtourism.com/columbus/nature-outdoor-activities/camping/short-creek-dam (403 to me) -> new https://www.burkecountynd.com/visitors (county's own listing). PHONE: 701-939-5681 matches the county page.

PIN: stored 48.99010,-102.78480 is ~150 m SW of the camping oval's centre (48.9908,-102.7826), at the entrance road junction: ok (under 250 m). Google's pin 48.98670,-102.77712 sits in a field ~650 m SE - ignore.
